changes.title: Dress spin
items: At the dressing stations she twirls on the spot each time you pick something new, and comes out of it wearing it

changes.title: Dress preview
items: At the wardrobe, dressing table and the other dressing stations, she changes as you move through the choices, without the long wait or the stutter

changes.title: Crown whole
items: The oak's crown is whole over the Terrace: no gap or notch, a bigger canopy to land in
The Terrace is one of the house's rooms: hidden under the crown from outside, like every room
Both are switches on the pause page (Oak crown), to flip back
